name: Shinonome Misuzu
source:
A woman who came to the island on the same ship as the protagonist.
Speaks politely and carries a calm demeanor,
but occasionally says something utterly unexpected.
She appears to be searching for a so-called "Uncharted Garden."
Seems well-traveled and knowledgeable about various matters.
Shining on her chest is a "Rhodonite" pendant.
